de-DE.etiquette: Strict privacy laws (KunstUrhG). Do not publish photos of people without consent.

fr-FR.warranty: Garantie légale de conformité de 2 ans
fr-FR.etiquette: Filming in museums often requires a 'autorisation de tournage'. Street photography is tolerated but be discreet.

it-IT.etiquette: Tripods are often banned inside churches and museums (e.g., Uffizi). Always ask 'Posso fare una foto?'

ja-JP.warranty: メーカー保証 1 年 (Manufacturer 1-year warranty)
ja-JP.etiquette: NEVER film people's faces without explicit permission. Drones are heavily restricted in Tokyo. No tripods on crowded sidewalks.

ko-KR.etiquette: Filming in palaces (Gyeongbokgung) requires permission for commercial gear. Do not film military zones.

zh-CN.warranty: 国家三包政策 (7 天退货，15 天换货，1 年保修)
zh-CN.etiquette: Drones require real-name registration and no-fly zone checks. Avoid filming government buildings or military infrastructure.

ar-SA.warranty: ضمان لمدة سنة واحدة من الوكيل المعتمد
ar-SA.etiquette: Avoid filming women without explicit consent. No photography inside mosques during prayer times. Respect modesty laws.

hi-IN.warranty: 1 वर्ष निर्माता वारंटी + विस्तृत वारंटी उपलब्ध
hi-IN.etiquette: Remove shoes before entering temples. Some religious sites prohibit photography. Ask 'kya main photo le sakta hoon?' before filming locals.

tr-TR.etiquette: Permission required for filming inside mosques. Dress modestly when filming religious sites. Avoid political gatherings.

ru-RU.warranty: Гарантия 1 год от производителя + защита прав потребителей
ru-RU.etiquette: No photography in metro stations without permission. Military zones strictly prohibited. Ask 'Можно снять?' before filming people.
